facts.value: The source declares a private four-element StageCallbacks array, grTKp_StageCallbacks, with three populated records and a final zero record, and an exported StageData object, grTKp_StageData, referencing that array. These declarations establish source-level configuration, not compiled section placement, adjacency or ordering.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing inference from source declaration order to writable compiled-section layout while retaining the supported object types and array extent.

evidence.why: Shows the complete array and descriptor declarations and initializers.
Exports the StageData object without establishing compiled placement.

facts.value: Stored in callback1 of grTKp_StageCallbacks[0]. If invoked, it ignores its Ground_GObj* argument, performs no reads, writes or calls, and returns false. The Ground_SetupStageCallbacks inline used by this unit does not read or install callback1, so this setup path does not establish runtime dispatch of the predicate.
facts.rationale: Preserves the constant-false behavior but removes the unsupported assertion of an installed callback1 dispatch path.

evidence.why: Shows the unused input and false result.
The actual installer does not consume callback1.
